translation.removeBackgroundDescription: The subject is detected automatically. The result keeps the original resolution and exports as a transparent PNG.
translation.removeBackgroundModelNote: The mask is computed at 512×512 and resized to the original dimensions; RGB values remain unchanged and only transparency is changed. First use downloads BiRefNet Lite 512 (MIT, about 94 MB with GPU or 183 MB with CPU). Processing is local; images are never uploaded.
translation.removeBackgroundUnsupported: Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP image.
translation.removeBackgroundEmptyPreview: The selected image preview will appear here.
translation.removeBackgroundReadError: Could not read the selected image.
translation.removeBackgroundDimensionError: The model returned an image with invalid dimensions.
translation.removeBackgroundLoadingModel: Downloading or loading the AI model…
translation.removeBackgroundHint: Original preview. The model detects the subject automatically.
translation.downloadVideoDescription: Paste one or more video links, one per line. Downloads run through yt-dlp.
translation.videosDropDescription: Add videos and reorder them before combining · processed locally
translation.combineVideosDescription: Combine videos without losing frame image quality; differing rates are kept as variable frame rate.
translation.combineVideosEmpty: Add at least two videos to get started.
translation.combinePdfsDescription: Merge PDFs locally in row order. The result is saved next to the first PDF as “<name> (combined).pdf”; existing names are numbered instead of overwritten.
translation.combinePdfsDropDescription: Add PDFs, then drag to set their order · processed locally
translation.combinePdfsListHint: Drag rows to reorder. Select rows and press Delete to remove them, or right-click for Remove / Show in Finder.
translation.combinePdfsUnlock: Unlock in Preview, then remove and add this PDF again.
translation.combinePdfsLockedFiles: {{count}} PDF(s) are password-protected and cannot be combined. Unlock them in Preview, then remove and add them again.
translation.combinePdfsInvalidFiles: {{count}} file(s) cannot be read as PDFs. Remove them to enable combining.
translation.combinePdfsEmpty: Add at least two PDFs to get started.
translation.splitPdfsDescription: Split each PDF into separate files by page ranges. Outputs are saved next to each original without overwriting existing files.
translation.splitPdfsDropDescription: Add one or more PDFs · each uses the same page ranges · processed locally
translation.splitPdfsRangesHint: Use 1-based page numbers separated by commas: 5 is page 5, 1-3 is pages 1–3, 8- is page 8 to the end, and -3 is the first page through 3. Leave blank to create one PDF per page.
translation.splitPdfsLockedFiles: {{count}} PDF(s) are password-protected and cannot be split. Unlock them in Preview, then remove and add them again.
translation.splitPdfsUnlock: Unlock in Preview, then remove and add this PDF again.
translation.splitPdfsInvalidFiles: {{count}} file(s) cannot be read as PDFs. Remove them to enable splitting.
translation.splitPdfsEmpty: Add at least one PDF to get started.
translation.organizePagesDescription: Reorder, remove, and preview pages. The original PDF is left unchanged; an organized copy is saved next to it. Available in the app only.
translation.organizePagesDropDescription: Choose one PDF to organize its pages · processed locally
translation.organizePagesHint: Drag a page; the highlighted card shows its new position (pages move to make room, not replace each other). Select pages and press Delete or right-click to remove them. Click a thumbnail to preview it.
translation.organizePagesKeepOne: Keep at least one page in the PDF.
translation.audioDropDescription: Add audio tracks, then drag to set their order · processed locally
translation.mergeAudioDescription: Join audio files into one continuous track, with optional chapter markers for M4B audiobooks.
translation.mergeAudioLosslessNote: When all files share a format, sample rate, and channel count, their audio streams are joined without re-encoding. Mixed files are re-encoded to the output format.
translation.mergeAudioChapterMarkers: Add chapter markers, named after each file
translation.mergeAudioListHint: Drag rows to reorder. Select rows and press Delete to remove them, or right-click for Remove / Show in Finder.
translation.mergeAudioInvalidFiles: {{count}} file(s) cannot be read as audio. Remove them to enable merging.
translation.mergeAudioEmpty: Add at least two audio files to get started.
translation.mergeAudioUnsupportedPreview: The format may not be supported by this player.
translation.splitByChapterDescription: Split a chapter-marked audio or video file into separate files, keeping chapter titles as filenames.
translation.splitByChapterDropTitle: Drop one chapter-marked media file here
translation.splitByChapterDropDescription: Supported audio and video formats · processed locally
translation.splitByChapterNoChapters: No chapters were found in this file. Choose a media file that contains chapter markers.
translation.splitByChapterPreviewUnsupported: This media format cannot be previewed by the audio player.
translation.appIconDescription: Generate icons ready for desktop, Apple devices, Android, and the web.
translation.appIconUnsupported: Choose an SVG, PNG, JPG, or WebP file.
translation.appIconSquareError: The image must be square (1:1 aspect ratio).
translation.appIconResolutionError: Resolution too low: at least 512×512 px is required.
translation.appIconRasterError: Could not rasterize the SVG to PNG.
translation.appIconIdealWarning: Resolution is valid; 1024×1024 px or higher is recommended for best quality.
translation.settingsDescription: Customize Biolaris Media to fit your preferences.
translation.settingsLaunchAtStartupDescription: Start Biolaris Media when you sign in to your computer.
translation.settingsAutoRenameOutputsDescription: If the name already exists, save another copy with suffixes such as _1, _2. Turn this off to show an error instead.
translation.settingsImagesDescription: Default format and export quality for images.
translation.settingsAudioDescription: Default format and export quality for audio.
translation.settingsVideosDescription: Default format and export quality for video.
translation.settingsPdfDescription: Image format and quality used to export PDF pages.
translation.settingsQualityByFormatDescription: Default value applied when you choose the matching format.

translation.privacyNote: Files are processed on your device. Downloading videos from links requires an internet connection and yt-dlp.
translation.compressDescription: Compress files to reduce their size
translation.cropDescription: Select an area of the image and save it as a new file.
translation.slideshowDescription: Choose images and turn them into an MP4 video.
translation.imagesDropDescription: Select multiple images in the order you want them to appear · processed locally
translation.slideshowEmpty: Add images to start building your slideshow.
translation.imageDropDescription: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP or SVG · processed locally
translation.cropUnsupportedImage: Choose a JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP or SVG image.
translation.cropImageDecodeError: This file cannot be shown as a preview. Choose a JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP or SVG image.
translation.cropDragHint: Drag over the image to select the area to crop.
translation.dropDescription: Images, video, audio and PDF · processed locally
translation.vectorizeDescription: Traces a raster image into a true SVG with real vector paths. Output is actual traced geometry you can scale to any size, not a bitmap wrapped in an SVG tag.
translation.vectorizeNextToSourceNote: Each SVG is written next to its source image with the same name. If a .svg already exists, a number is added so nothing is overwritten.
translation.vectorizeDropDescription: PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, or WebP · Output is always SVG · processed locally
translation.vectorizeStyleLogoDesc: Logos, icons, and flat color art. Traces smooth, filled color shapes.
translation.vectorizeStylePhotoDesc: Photographs and images with gradients or fine detail.
translation.vectorizeStyleBwDesc: Line art, sketches, and anything you want as a clean black-and-white trace.
translation.vectorizeEmpty: Add raster images to vectorize them into true SVG paths.
translation.vectorizeSupportedInputs: Supported inputs: PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, and WebP. Output is always SVG.
